name: documentation-tooling-selection
description: Select documentation tooling for the adopted strategy: static site generators (Docusaurus / MkDocs / Astro / Nextra / VitePress), developer portals (Backstage TechDocs / Port), wikis (Confluence / Notion / Outline), API reference tools (Redoc / Scalar / Stoplight / Swagger UI), learning platforms, single-page vs docs-as-code. Criteria: docs-as-code fit, versioning, search, localization, publishing pipeline, theming, plugin ecosystem, cost, lock-in. Hand-off to documentation-strategy for IA decisions.
